articles.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
articles.snippet: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

articles.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

articles.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
articles.snippet: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
articles.snippet: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
articles.snippet: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.
